composition_variation: Create an original premium 2D anime wallpaper of exactly one woman, visibly 28 years old, with sage-brown hair in a softly textured pixie cut with a longer swept fringe. She has mature, self-assured elegance and realistic adult proportions. Design expressive amber-green eyes, a beautifully balanced face, a softly angular jaw, and a cheerful confident smile. Her opaque muted-coral sleeveless collared top is paired with cream ankle-length linen trousers and brown flat sandals. She gently opens a small wooden garden gate with one hand near her waist, while the other holds a folded straw hat close to her hip. Her body faces mostly forward with a slight natural turn. Layered ferns, mossy stones, and a curving arboretum path create quiet depth at the bottom. Fresh early-summer sunlight passes through foliage, painting subtle golden edges on her hair. Frame at eye level for a very tall phone crop. Keep her face, body, and hands inside the central narrow column, in the middle and lower image; leave the upper 25% calm and mostly empty for the clock. Natural nonsexual posture, opaque summer clothing, graceful anatomy, small readable hands close to her body. Refined linework, layered cel shading, painterly light, no text, logos, other people, or copied characters.
